stories.title: Funko beats earnings estimates by $0.06, revenue tops forecasts
stories.summary: Funko reported quarterly earnings per share $0.06 above analyst estimates. Revenue for the period also topped forecasts. The report gives no further detail on guidance or segment results.
stories.whyItMatters: A beat at Funko is a read on demand for discretionary, lower-ticket consumer goods heading into the holiday season.
questions: What drove the beat—sales growth or cost control?
